gym.product.name: Gym
gym.product.band.title: Log the set. The rest is remembered.
gym.product.band.sub: Two taps between sets, and the next session opens with last time’s numbers.
gym.product.section.title: It remembers what you lifted.
gym.product.section.sub: A training log for barbell programs. Two taps between sets, and the next session opens with last time’s numbers already in the field.
gym.product.section.trust: Free to use by hand. Your log stays on your Windmill account.
gym.product.proof.tapsCopy: Load and reps are prefilled from last time. Tap to log, tap to rest.
gym.product.proof.remembersCopy: Every session opens with your last loads for that movement.
gym.product.proof.toolsCopy: Connect Claude, Cursor or any MCP client to read and write your log.
gym.landingHead.title: Windmill Gym — a training log that remembers what you lifted
gym.landingHead.description: A training log for barbell programs — squat, bench, deadlift, press, rows, chins. Two taps between sets, and the next session opens with last time’s numbers already in the field. e1RM per lift over time, and a link that shares one workout.
gym.landingHead.shareTitle: Windmill Gym — it remembers what you lifted
gym.landingHead.shareDescription: A training log for barbell programs — squat, bench, deadlift, press, rows, chins. Two taps between sets, and the next session opens with last time’s numbers already in the field.
gym.landingHead.notesHow: How it works: Log the set → It remembers → See the line.
gym.landingHead.notesLine: e1RM per lift over time, and a link that shares one workout.
gym.landingHead.schemaDescription: A training log for barbell programs. Log a set in two taps, and the next session opens with last time’s numbers already in the field. e1RM per lift over time, sets and sessions per week, and a revocable link that shares one workout.
gym.landing.accountLine: Your log lives on your Windmill account — one account across Roadmap, Journal and Gym.
gym.landing.hero.title: It remembers what you lifted.
gym.landing.hero.sub: A training log for barbell programs — squat, bench, deadlift, press, rows, chins. Two taps between sets, a small jump when it’s time, and the next session opens with last time’s numbers already in the field.
gym.landing.scenes.why: Three sessions at 100 × 5 with reps to spare.
